title: Slot vocabulary
description: The placeholder vocabulary, derived from cross-repo usage rather than invented. Each slot is validated by the runtime `slot` schema, which is the published contract and already carries the example rule -- every example names its source repo and a reuse status, an example may carry empty `raw_ids` only when the artifact yielded none, and such an example must carry our own description instead. Repeating any of that here would create a second copy free to drift from the first.

slots.description: Every multi-source slot carries examples from at least two different source repos: an overlap across repos is the strongest signal that a slot belongs in the defaults, and a single-repo slot does not have that signal. The cross-record rule is the validator's, not the schema's.
